Contributing to geokit

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Thanks for considering a contribution!

Development setup

geokit uses a Rust backend for URL resolution and SOFT parsing. To build from source you need the Rust toolchain (cargo and rustc, see the SystemRequirements field in DESCRIPTION) in addition to R.

git clone https://github.com/WangLabCSU/geokit.git
Rscript -e 'pkgload::load_all(".")'

Pull requests

  • Work on a feature branch and keep pull requests focused on one change.
  • Add or update tests in tests/testthat/ for behavior changes. Tests that hit NCBI should use skip_if_download_fail() (download layer) so they skip gracefully when the network is unavailable.
  • Keep roxygen documentation in R/*.R in sync with the code and regenerate the man/ pages with roxygen2::roxygenise() when docs change.
  • Record user-visible changes in NEWS.md under the development-version section.
  • CI runs R CMD check on Linux, macOS, and Windows plus test coverage; please keep it green.

Reporting issues

Include your R version, geokit version (packageVersion("geokit")), and a minimal reproducible example. For download problems, mention whether an NCBI API key (ENTREZ_KEY) is set and whether your environment can reach ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov.
